# BitterPass Public Context

## Product Sentence

BitterPass is an operator-approved credential authority for teams whose agents
touch production APIs, cloud consoles, billing systems, and internal control
planes.

## User And Job

The user is an operator, platform owner, security-minded founder, or technical
team whose agents and MCP tools need to touch real systems without inheriting a
human's broad credentials or one immortal service account.

The job is to keep a human approval step while letting a runner receive scoped
material for a bounded run, then leave receipts that can be reviewed later.

## Object Loop

```text
Operator -> Passkey Session -> Runner Identity -> Scoped Bundle -> Receipts -> Expiry/Revocation
```

## Bitter Role

Bitter is the agent-operable software environment. BitterPass owns the
credential-authority part of that environment. Factory, BitterGrid, BitterHub,
and marketing surfaces can link to BitterPass receipts, but they do not become
the authority for issuance, expiry, revocation, or audit state.

## Boundary And Not-X

BitterPass is not a generic password manager, deployment executor,
account/billing layer, public recovery runbook, or marketing-site login system.
The public marketing repository does not contain passkey ceremony payloads,
vault unlock logic, credential values, pairing tokens, recovery material,
approved-customer onboarding packets, or private support/debug material.

## Live Proof

The public marketing root is `https://bitterpass.com/`. The CLI setup overview
is `https://bitterpass.com/cli-setup/`. The release identity path is
`https://bitterpass.com/up/`. The console surface is
`https://app.bitterpass.com/`. Access requests and support start at
`https://bitterdesk.com/`.

## Claim Ledger

- Live-proven: public marketing routes, health/release identity, console route,
  BitterDesk route, Bitter account bridge routes, private-launch request CTA.
- Source-proven: static Nuxt marketing site, Radicchio manifest, ops manifest,
  public smoke tests, Markdown alternates, AI-readable discovery files, and
  marketing-only repository boundary.
- Private: passkey ceremony details, vault unlock behavior, credential values,
  runner bundle issuance, root-secret custody, recovery material, and
  customer-specific onboarding packets.
- Future or remove: zero-knowledge, no-service-plaintext,
  no-vendor-root-secret, and recovery guarantees unless backed by an approved
  proof packet that is intentionally public.

## CTA Truth

Request access through BitterDesk. Invited users open BitterPass Console.
Login and signup bridge through Bitter account surfaces. Detailed CLI commands,
pairing steps, runner enrollment, and recovery material are invitation-gated.

## Current Public Copy

BitterPass is for teams whose agents and MCP tools touch production APIs, cloud
consoles, billing systems, and internal control planes. It replaces broad
service accounts, copied environment variables, and unauditable bot access with
human approval, per-run scope, revocation, and receipts.

The product contract is a bounded onboarding proof: operator approval, runner
identity, scoped material, and receipts before the first production pull.
